linking words für clauses of result: so, therefore

atoms.b:
In a neighbourhood, Mia and Liam became friends ((because)) of their shared love for exploring nature. ((Since)) their interests aligned, they often spent afternoons discovering nature trails together.
One day, inspired by their neighbours, Mia suggested building a treehouse in an old oak tree. ((As)) they were spending so much time building it, the treehouse stood tall. Mia and Liam invited other friends to the treehouse ((so)) it became a place of laughter and shared adventures.

instruction.sound: Setze die passenden <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>linking words</voice> ein.

atoms.b: ((++As So Therefore)) a product of their strong friendship, they always support each other.
They communicated honestly ((++so when since)) their relationship deepened.
((++Because Therefore So)) they are the same age, they understand each other's struggles.
They had planned for a year ((++so as since)) they could go on holiday together.
((Therefore ++Since So)) they come from different cultures, they have different holidays.
They underwent conflict resolution training ((++therefore because as)) their communication skills improved.
